tasks.gr9-development-of-self-t1: Topic: Development of the Self in Society. Cover values, self-awareness, self-motivation, goal setting, and decision-making. Ask learners to reflect on their personal values, explain how values influence choices, set SMART goals, evaluate decision-making scenarios, or analyse how self-awareness supports personal growth.
tasks.gr9-relationships-life-changes-t1: Topic: Relationships and Life Changes. Cover peer and family relationships, emotions, self-respect, conflict, and support. Ask learners to describe healthy relationships, explain emotional changes during adolescence, identify healthy boundaries, analyse relationship conflicts, or discuss how to manage peer pressure.
tasks.gr9-study-skills-transition-t1: Topic: Study Skills and Transition Planning. Cover subject demands, concentration, revision habits, and preparation for Grade 10. Ask learners to create study timetables, describe effective study techniques, explain how subject demands vary, reflect on their study strengths, or plan for Grade 10 preparation.
tasks.gr9-physical-education-task-1-t1: Topic: Physical Education Task — Term 1. Cover fitness development, coordination, teamwork, and safe participation. Ask learners to complete fitness assessments, demonstrate coordination exercises, reflect on teamwork experiences, keep fitness logs, or explain how to prevent injuries in physical activity.
